panels.title: Data through · latest completed scrape
panels.description: Latest completed successful observation for any tracked category. This is data freshness, not page freshness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(last_success_at) AS data_through FROM dashboard_public.freshness

panels.title: Observed active listings by category and deal
panels.description: Distinct observed OLX article IDs, active under the existing 14-day rule. Category counts overlap when one article belongs to multiple saved searches.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, deal, count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS observed_active_listings
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(category_memberships) AS categories(category)
WHERE category IN ('apartments','houses','vacation_homes')
GROUP BY category, deal
ORDER BY category, deal

panels.title: Sale asking summaries
panels.description: Median asking KM/m² for valid priced sale listings. Sample size is shown; no cross-category pooled headline is calculated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS priced_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS median_asking_km_m2
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(category_memberships) AS categories(category)
WHERE category IN ('apartments','houses','vacation_homes')
  AND deal = 'sale' AND ppm2 > 0
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

panels.title: Rent asking summaries · period as listed
panels.description: Rental asking prices are shown without assuming a monthly lease period; is_rent alone does not establish the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS priced_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price))::int AS median_asking_km
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(category_memberships) AS categories(category)
WHERE category IN ('apartments','houses','vacation_homes')
  AND deal = 'rent' AND price > 0
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

panels.title: Newly observed active listings · 7 days
panels.description: Distinct article IDs first observed in the last seven days and still active. Renewals are not counted as new.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, deal, count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS new_active_listings
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(category_memberships) AS categories(category)
WHERE category IN ('apartments','houses','vacation_homes')
  AND first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY category, deal
ORDER BY category, deal

panels.title: Recent asking-price reductions
panels.description: Resolved valid-to-valid reductions in the last seven days. The event price and current availability are distinct facts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title, url, deal, neighborhood, prior_price, new_price, reduction_km, reduction_pct, event_at, currently_observed
FROM dashboard_public.price_reductions
WHERE event_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND category_memberships && ARRAY['apartments','houses','vacation_homes']::text[]
ORDER BY event_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Freshness by tracked category
panels.description: A missing completed success is Unknown. The value reflects the latest successful scrape, not a visitor refresh.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, configured_searches, last_success_at, CASE WHEN last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN last_success_at < now() - INTERVAL '26 hours' THEN 'Stale' ELSE 'Current' END AS freshness
FROM dashboard_public.freshness
WHERE category IN ('apartments','houses','vacation_homes')
ORDER BY category
